summary: v0.2.0 is built and tagged: an org-installable skill with stdlib seeder and checker, single-source principles with drift checks, agent and skill kinds, and a UserPromptSubmit offer hook verified live through the installed plugin. Sixteen findings recorded; F-015 (project kind) and F-016 (planning/ vs docs/) carried into Review. Phase is Build until the author approves Review.

decisions.summary: Primary deliverable is an org-installable skill.
One source per principle; copies generated and drift-checked.
Local check advisory; CI in seeded projects binds.
agent and skill kinds; project kind has its evidence (F-015).
Adapters stay substantive and point at the skill; resume is a briefing.
project.status records paused, abandoned, archived alongside the phase.
Explicit invocation first; a hook offers the skill once per session on new work.

next_action: Obtain the author's explicit approval to enter Review; then make the plugin Available for install and collect friction per docs/INSTALL.md.
